items.html: *And behold, the third Tevuna, which is the second, is where all the Mochin and Tzelem of ZA are clothed. (Even though in the first discourse in this booklet we said that the Mem of Tzelem alone is clothed in the first six of Tevuna as mentioned above, until the chest, and from there downward is the Tzadi-Lamed of Tzelem — this is not so, and the true order is: the Mem is in the head of Tevuna as Chochma-Bina-Daat; the Lamed is in Chesed-Gevura-Tiferet; the Tzadi is in Netzach-Hod-Yesod.)
